outcome: pattern of hysterectomy (including age distribution, indications, and surgical routes)
cohort: The study included 150 patients who underwent elective hysterectomy at Rama Medical College & Hospital in Hapur between October 2022 and September 2023.
finding: The majority of elective hysterectomies were performed in women aged 41-50 years, primarily for symptomatic uterine fibroids, and predominantly via the abdominal route.
